text:
alex.g: hey team, first week question — I'm trying to push to redwood/inference-core but getting a 403 and GitHub says 2FA required. I accepted the org invite but I don't see any teams assigned. anyone know the usual culprits?
jamie: welcome! do you know which email you accepted the invite with (work vs personal)? sometimes SSO requires the org email.
alex.g: i accepted with alex.g@gmail.com (my personal). i also have alex@redwood.com but the invite link I got initially went to personal.
it-support: hey @alex.g — can you paste the exact git error and `ssh -T git@github.com` output? also confirm you turned on 2FA on your GH account.
alex.g: `git push origin main` -> `remote: Permission to redwood/inference-core.git denied to alexg.`
`git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).` i did enable 2FA yesterday.
maria: did you join via SSO? if you accepted the org invite but didn't do the 'Sign in with SSO' flow you won't be provisioned into teams. check Settings → Organizations → Redwood Inference in your GH profile.
alex.g: it shows "You are not a member of any teams" on the repo access page.
eli: @jamie @maria — can you check if SCIM/provisioning is queued? sometimes team membership sync lags and we need to reprovision.
jamie: triggered SCIM reprovision for alex.g. can you try logging out and back into GitHub and then open the org invitation URL? https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation
alex.g: logged out/in, re-opened. still no invite bubble. is there a way to re-send the invite?
it-support: resent invites to both alex.g@gmail.com and alex@redwood.com. also made sure SSO prompt is visible: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/security/sso — check that and click "Sign in with SSO" if prompted.
alex.g: got a new invite to alex@redwood.com, accepted it. now i see teams populated but pushing still fails — ssh still says Permission denied.
maria: can you paste your public key (just the .pub) here? run `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` or the key you added. don't paste private keys.
alex.g: ```ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEfakedkeyblob12345alex.g@gmail.com```
eli: key format looks correct. i checked org settings — the key wasn't on your account, it was added as a deploy key on a different repo by mistake. please add that public key to your GitHub profile under Settings → SSH and GPG keys.
alex.g: added it to my profile now. re-ran `ssh -T git@github.com` and it prints `Hi alexg! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.`
alex.g: trying push again... it worked! :tada: thanks everyone for the quick help.
maria: nice, welcome aboard again :party-parrot: — ping if anything else is weird with repo perms or if you need access to any private infra repos.
it-support: leaving a note in the onboarding ticket to double-check invite email flow for future hires (avoid personal-email invites).
